_doc: NPCs. raft = platform id in rafts.json. schedule entries: from/to hour (to < from wraps past midnight), do = animation/activity, at = structure spot kind on that raft or pos = [x, z]. role: trader | mechanic | elder | lookout | water | resident. talk = lines; a line may require a story flag (if) or set one (set). The first unseen matching line is spoken, then they cycle the rest.

talk.text: Morning. Stay on that side of the table, if you don't mind. Nothing personal.
Scrap for supplies. The sealed tins come from Highmark. Don't ask what they cost us.
If you find copper or batteries, I'll give you better than the Wardens would.
Sealed goods are counted. Every tin. Someone always comes to count.
That hull of yours is mostly patches holding hands. Use the bench if you've got the parts.
Hook and rope? Rope from fibre, a hook from scrap. Bench does the rest.
Fuel's dear. Highmark sells it back to us by the cup. We sold it to them by the barrel, once.
You came out of Linden Court? Then you're one of the quiet ones. Welcome to Kettle Drift. Keep your distance and we'll get on.
If you hear a voice on the radio that isn't Highmark's, write the numbers down. Some of us still listen.
Those numbers. That's the Sounding, where the plaza fell in. The Unmoored put a buoy there. Lower their hydrophone, and listen. Go at night if you must go at all.
We don't dive at night. Not because of the dark.
Highmark says the sea is just the sea. Highmark doesn't live on it.
Wardens pass at night. Red light, then the searchlight. If it finds you, keep your hands where they can see them.
I counted the lighthouse once. Every forty seconds. It never misses.
Gulls go quiet before it happens. Before the sound. You'll notice.
Beans, kale, a bit of potato. Salt's the enemy. Rain's the friend.
Mum says not to stand close to anyone. I don't mind. You look tired.
Boiled, filtered, and tested. Two scrap a bottle. Highmark water's cleaner and you'll pay in other ways.
Mask's habit. I know it's gone. Habits outlive reasons.
Fish stew. Mostly stew. Some fish.
My brother went to Highmark on a work permit. Writes every month. Same letter every month.
Fish don't come up near the Sounding any more. Not since the lights.
If you're smuggling, I didn't see you. If you're not, you should be.
Ward 9 was where they kept the ones who stopped talking. My sister was a nurse there.
They sealed it with people inside. That's not a rumour, love. That's paperwork.
Tie up wherever. Pay what you like. Mother Ansel's on the Quiet Deck if you need her.
There's a bunk on the Stacks for anyone who needs one. Sleep's free. Dreams cost extra.
